name: László Kovács
bio:
László Kovács's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during his mandatory military service, where his aptitude for mechanics was quickly identified. After an honorable discharge, he leveraged that experience into an apprenticeship at a local garage specializing in vintage rally cars. His knack for problem-solving and his meticulous attention to detail soon propelled him into management roles within the shop.

He joined Ipiranga Racing a decade ago, initially as a senior mechanic. His proven ability to streamline operations and foster a collaborative environment quickly earned him the head of operations role. László believes in empowering his team, providing them with the resources and autonomy they need to excel. His focus is on optimizing logistical efficiency and ensuring seamless communication between all departments, a philosophy that’s made him indispensable.

 László is particularly adept at identifying and resolving bottlenecks, often employing unconventional solutions inspired by his background in vintage car restoration. He’s known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his unwavering commitment to the team's success.

physical.description: A stocky man with a permanent air of quiet intensity.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously drawn diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on personally checking the torque settings on critical components before every race.
